subjects.name: 天文学
subjects.eyebrow: 从地球出发，重新认识宇宙
subjects.description: 看见天体的形状、运动与尺度，沿着问题一步步走进太阳系。
subjects.description_en: Explore the shapes, motions, and scale of celestial bodies as you journey into the Solar System.

topics.name: 太阳系
topics.description: 从一颗恒星出发，认识八颗行星与太阳系的边界。
topics.description_en: Start with our star and explore the eight planets and the outer Solar System.

lessons.name: 太阳系行星图鉴
lessons.description: 旋转、靠近并观察太阳与行星。
lessons.description_en: Rotate, zoom in, and observe the Sun and planets.

lessons.name: 太阳系结构
lessons.description: 从行星轨道走向柯伊伯带与奥尔特云。
lessons.description_en: Travel from planetary orbits to the Kuiper Belt and Oort Cloud.

subjects.name: 物理学
subjects.description: 从一辆汽车开始，观察受力、运动与牛顿三大定律。
subjects.description_en: Use a car to explore forces, motion, and Newton's three laws.

topics.name: 力与运动
topics.description: 通过一辆可操作的 3D 汽车，观察受力图与牛顿三大定律。
topics.description_en: Use an interactive 3D car to study force diagrams and Newton's three laws.

lessons.name: 牛顿车库
lessons.description: 切换运动状态、调节质量与驱动力，完成五章互动实验与课堂挑战。
lessons.description_en: Change motion states, mass, and driving force across five interactive chapters.
lessons.interaction: 3D 汽车 · 双语 · 五章实验

subjects.name: 生物学
subjects.description: 观察生命的形态与结构。具体演示将随课程逐步加入。
subjects.description_en: Observe the forms and structures of living things. Interactive lessons will be added over time.

subjects.name: 化学
subjects.description: 用可视化模型理解物质的组成与变化。具体演示将随课程逐步加入。
subjects.description_en: Use visual models to understand what matter is made of and how it changes. Lessons are coming soon.
